sources.title: SAP AI Core | Deploy, Orchestrate, Govern AI Models and Assets
sources.snippet: SAP AI Core is a fully managed AI service on the SAP Business AI Platform, designed to operate, govern, and scale AI workloads in a standardized and scalable way. It provides centralized model management, flexible deployment, integrated development, and tabular AI tools to streamline enterprise AI adoption.
